notice-board: Pinned notes and drawings, no words. Every merge recipe anyone finds ends up here, usually with a doodle of two Checklings going in and one coming out. Weekly rankings go up here once rank points start.
arena: Battles are open! Walk up to any trainer and press C to challenge them. Town trainers and the Champion will wait inside these gates later on.
market-stall: The merchant is still unpacking crates. Soon anything a trainer sells here shows up for everyone else at a higher price.
merge-stone: Two Checklings go in. One rare Checkling comes out. The spirals were here before the first people came to the valley, and they are quiet for now.
bus: The bus to Kettle Creek. Never late. Occasionally not running, which is different.
bus-stop: Every trainer steps off the bus right here. The bench is always a little damp.
lantern: Lit every evening by nobody in particular. The first posts went up because a Checkling called Lantern refused to come inside one dark night.
bench: Where trainers wait for someone brave enough to challenge them.
rock: Bolt has inspected this rock. Bolt approves.
bush: It rustles sometimes. Brambles hide berries in bushes like this one, then forget which bush.
